append.detail: ── PARKED 2026-09-30. OWNER RULING 2026-09-30 ~01:35Z (multiple choice, recorded by HYG-156, ADR-1672): "Park until 75 users". REVISIT TRIGGER: reopen when Google identities in auth.identities (provider google) reach 75. Google's unverified cap is 100; the count was about 32 on 2026-08-19. For whoever reads the trigger: this row's 2026-08-25 correction says the cap itself counts contacts.readonly grants (1 of 100 on 2026-09-08), not sign-ins. Google identities are always at least that number, so the owner's meter fires early, never late. The closing test is unchanged (record the demo video and submit verification) and is not run while parked.
